interactions.name: Marchesa death trigger and delayed return
interactions.note: Marchesa creates a delayed trigger for the beginning of the next end step when a controlled creature with a +1/+1 counter dies. If that delayed trigger is created after an end step has already begun, it waits for the next turn's end step.

interactions.name: Persist plus +1/+1 counter support
interactions.note: Persist returns a creature with a -1/-1 counter if it died without one. +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters remove each other as a state-based action, allowing the persist creature to be reset for another loop when the deck supplies a +1/+1 counter.

interactions.name: Spark Double + Glen Elendra Archmage + Ashnod's Altar
interactions.note: The indexed loop uses Spark Double copying Glen Elendra Archmage and Ashnod's Altar; counter-state resetting and repeated sacrifice/return create repeatable mana/counterspell-engine functionality under the stated prerequisites.

interactions.name: Murderous Redcap + Gev, Scaled Scorch
interactions.note: After an opponent has lost life this turn, Gev causes returning creatures to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter; this offsets Redcap's persist -1/-1 counter and supports a repeatable death/ETB damage loop with a suitable sacrifice outlet.

interactions.name: Murderous Redcap + Metallic Mimic
interactions.note: Metallic Mimic naming Goblin causes Redcap to enter with a +1/+1 counter, allowing persist's -1/-1 counter to be canceled and enabling repeatable Redcap sacrifice/return with a free outlet.

interactions.name: Altar of Dementia as sacrifice outlet and payoff
interactions.note: Altar sacrifices creatures at no mana cost and mills based on sacrificed power, turning established repeatable creature loops into deterministic library depletion.

interactions.name: Satoru, the Infiltrator with Marchesa returns
interactions.note: Creatures returned by Marchesa or persist enter the battlefield without being cast, satisfying Satoru's trigger condition and converting recursion events into card draw.

interactions.name: Twilight Diviner with graveyard returns
interactions.note: Once each turn, qualifying other creatures entering from a graveyard can trigger Twilight Diviner to create a token copy, directly rewarding Marchesa/persist returns.

interactions.name: Danny Pink counter draw
interactions.note: Danny Pink triggers the first time one or more counters are put on a creature you control each turn; dethrone and the deck's dedicated +1/+1-counter engines can satisfy that condition.

interactions.name: Agatha's Soul Cauldron counter and ability sharing
interactions.note: The Cauldron can exile creature cards from graveyards, put a +1/+1 counter on a creature, and grant activated abilities of creature cards it exiled to creatures you control with +1/+1 counters, matching the deck's counter infrastructure.

interactions.name: Forge of Heroes on Marchesa
interactions.note: Forge can target a commander that entered the battlefield this turn and put a +1/+1 counter on it if it is a creature; it does not require that commander to have been cast from the command zone.

interactions.name: Sneak Attack and Marchesa end-step timing
interactions.note: Sneak Attack grants haste and creates an end-step sacrifice trigger. If that sacrifice occurs during the end step, Marchesa's newly created delayed return trigger waits until the following turn's end step because the current beginning-of-end-step event has already passed.

interactions.name: Flare of Denial alternate cost
interactions.note: Flare's alternate cost may sacrifice a nontoken blue creature. If that sacrificed creature has a +1/+1 counter while Marchesa is controlled, its death can create Marchesa's delayed return trigger.
